hindi: दण्ड-पारुष्य: स्पर्श करना, धमकाना, प्रहार करना।
english: Physical injury: touching, threatening, striking.
notes: Verbless list; the closing iti is not rendered. daṇḍa-pāruṣya = physical injury in the offences of Book 3 (glossary). avagūrṇa is taken as threatening (raising the hand or a weapon to strike); alternative: brandishing. prahata = striking, a blow.
lines_deva: दण्ड.पारुष्यं स्पर्शनम् अवगूर्णं प्रहतम् इति
lines_iast: daṇḍa.pāruṣyaṃ sparśanam avagūrṇaṃ prahatam iti

words.gloss: vomit, urine, excrement, and the like

hindi: नाभि से नीचे के शरीर को हाथ, कीचड़, भस्म, धूल से छूने वाले का तीन पण का दण्ड; उन्हीं अपवित्रों से और पैर और थूक से छह पण; वमन, मूत्र, मल आदि से बारह पण।
english: For one touching the body below the navel with hand, mud, ash [or] dust, the penalty [is] three paṇas; with those same impure [things] and with foot [and] spittle, six paṇas; with vomit, urine, excrement and the like, twelve paṇas.
notes: The closing iti after the list of four substances is not rendered. "tair eva amedhyaiḥ" is taken as: with those same impure things (the mud, ash, dust just named); the referent is not stated. ṣṭhīvikā is taken as spittle (spelling printed pāda.ṣṭhīvikābhyāṃ, possibly for pāda-niṣṭhīvikābhyām; not flagged as a certain error). paṇa stays a unit name.
lines_deva: नाभेर् अधः.कायं हस्त.पङ्क.भस्म.पांसुभिर् इति स्पृशतस् त्रि.पणो दण्डः, तैर् एव-अमेध्यैः पाद.ष्ठीविकाभ्यां च षट्.पणः, छर्दि.मूत्र.पुरीष.आदिभिर् द्वादश.पणः
lines_iast: nābher adhaḥ.kāyaṃ hasta.paṅka.bhasma.pāṃsubhir iti spṛśatas tri.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, tair eva-amedhyaiḥ pāda.ṣṭhīvikābhyāṃ ca ṣaṭ.paṇaḥ, chardi.mūtra.purīṣa.ādibhir dvādaśa.paṇaḥ

hindi: नाभि के ऊपर दुगुने, सिर पर चौगुने, समानों में।
english: Above the navel double, on the head fourfold, among equals.
notes: The noun (the penalties, daṇḍāḥ) is not stated and is not supplied. sameṣu = among (persons of) equal rank, taken with the rule of unit 2.
lines_deva: नाभेर् उपरि द्वि.गुणाः, शिरसि चतुर्.गुणाः समेषु
lines_iast: nābher upari dvi.guṇāḥ, śirasi catur.guṇāḥ sameṣu

words.gloss: carelessness, intoxication, delusion, and the like

hindi: विशिष्टों में दुगुने, हीनों में आधे दण्ड, दूसरों की स्त्रियों में दुगुने, प्रमाद, मद, मोह आदि से आधे दण्ड।
english: Among the superior double, among the inferior half penalties, among others' wives double, through carelessness, intoxication, delusion and the like half penalties.
notes: Verbless; read as an extension of units 2-3 (penalties depending on the rank of the person touched). viśiṣṭa = distinguished/superior; Hindi विशिष्टों as in glossary 3.18.
lines_deva: विशिष्टेषु द्वि.गुणाः, हीनेष्व् अर्ध.दण्डाः, पर.स्त्रीषु द्वि.गुणाः, प्रमाद.मद.मोह.आदिभिर् अर्ध.दण्डाः
lines_iast: viśiṣṭeṣu dvi.guṇāḥ, hīneṣv ardha.daṇḍāḥ, para.strīṣu dvi.guṇāḥ, pramāda.mada.moha.ādibhir ardha.daṇḍāḥ

words.gloss: in seizing foot, garment, hand, hair

hindi: पैर, वस्त्र, हाथ, केश पकड़ने में छह पण अधिक के दण्ड।
english: In seizing by the foot, garment, hand [or] hair, penalties higher by six paṇas.
notes: ṣaṭ-paṇa-uttara taken literally as having six paṇas as the "higher/further" part, i.e. six paṇas upward. Alternatives: penalties increasing by six paṇas (each step); six paṇas as the lowest. avalambana = hanging on to, seizing. Rendered "higher by six paṇas" as fixed in glossary 3.18 (X-paṇa-uttara); "six paṇas upward" remains an alternative reading.
lines_deva: पाद.वस्त्र.हस्त.केश.अवलम्बनेषु षट्.पण.उत्तरा दण्डाः
lines_iast: pāda.vastra.hasta.keśa.avalambaneṣu ṣaṭ.paṇa.uttarā daṇḍāḥ

words.gloss: in pressing, clasping, pulling, dragging, sitting upon

hindi: दबाने, लपेटने, खींचने, घसीटने, ऊपर बैठने में प्रथम साहस-दण्ड।
english: In pressing, clasping, pulling, dragging [or] sitting upon, the first fine for rashness.
notes: añcana is taken as pulling (drawing); āveṣṭana as enclosing/clasping; adhyāsana as sitting on. Senses of the middle members are medium confidence.
lines_deva: पीडन.आवेष्टन.अञ्चन.प्रकर्षण.अध्यासनेषु पूर्वः साहस.दण्डः
lines_iast: pīḍana.āveṣṭana.añcana.prakarṣaṇa.adhyāsaneṣu pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. apa-√kram

hindi: गिराकर चले जाने वाले का आधा दण्ड।
english: For one who goes away after having caused [him] to fall, a half penalty.
notes: The object of pātayitvā is not stated; "[him]" is supplied in English only.
lines_deva: पातयित्वा-अपक्रामतो ऽर्ध.दण्डः
lines_iast: pātayitvā-apakrāmato 'rdha.daṇḍaḥ

hindi: जिस अंग से शूद्र ब्राह्मण पर प्रहार करे, उसका वह कटवाए।
english: With whichever limb a śūdra strikes a brāhmaṇa, that [limb] of his [one] should have cut off.
notes: The subject of chedayet is not stated ("[one]"). The token asyac-chedayet is asya + chedayet (regular ch > cch after a short vowel; hyphen join in the e-text).
lines_deva: शूद्रो येन-अङ्गेन ब्राह्मणम् अभिहन्यात् तद् अस्यच्-छेदयेत्
lines_iast: śūdro yena-aṅgena brāhmaṇam abhihanyāt tad asyac-chedayet

hindi: धमकाने में निष्क्रय, स्पर्श में आधा दण्ड।
english: In threatening, redemption; in touching, a half penalty.
notes: Continues unit 8 (a śūdra and a brāhmaṇa). niṣkraya = redemption, i.e. buying oneself off; the exact form is not stated. avagūrṇa kept as in unit 1.
lines_deva: अवगूर्णे निष्क्रयः, स्पर्शे ऽर्ध.दण्डः
lines_iast: avagūrṇe niṣkrayaḥ, sparśe 'rdha.daṇḍaḥ

hindi: इससे चाण्डालों और अपवित्रों की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By that, the caṇḍālas and the impure are explained.
notes: Formula "tena X vyākhyātaḥ"; the verb is singular though two subjects (as glossary 4.4). aśuci = impure [persons]; who is meant is not stated.
lines_deva: तेन चण्डाल.अशुचयो व्याख्यातः
lines_iast: tena caṇḍāla.aśucayo vyākhyātaḥ

words.gloss: having three paṇas as the lower [limit]
having twelve paṇas as the upper [limit]

hindi: हाथ से धमकाने में तीन पण निम्न सीमा वाला, बारह पण उच्च सीमा वाला दण्ड, पैर से दुगुना, दुःख उत्पन्न करने वाले द्रव्य से प्रथम साहस-दण्ड, प्राण को संकट में डालने वाले से मध्यम।
english: For threatening with the hand, the penalty [has] three paṇas as the lower [limit] and twelve paṇas as the upper; with the foot, double; with an article causing pain, the first fine for rashness; with [an article] endangering life, the middle.
notes: tri-paṇa-avara / dvādaśa-paṇa-para are paired as lower and upper limit; the 4.10 rendering "X paṇas or lower" does not fit this paired use; the range rendering of glossary 3.17 (lower [limit] / upper [limit]) is used. Range 3 to 12 paṇas. madhyamaḥ is left bare (glossary 4.11); prāṇa-ābādhikena qualifies an unstated dravya.
lines_deva: हस्तेन-अवगूर्णे त्रि.पण.अवरो द्वादश.पण.परो दण्डः, पादेन द्वि.गुणः, दुःख.उत्पादनेन द्रव्येण पूर्वः साहस.दण्डः, प्राण.आबाधिकेन मध्यमः
lines_iast: hastena-avagūrṇe tri.paṇa.avaro dvādaśa.paṇa.paro daṇḍaḥ, pādena dvi.guṇaḥ, duḥkha.utpādanena dravyeṇa pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, prāṇa.ābādhikena madhyamaḥ

words.gloss: of the articles wood, clod, stone, iron, stick, rope

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. caus. ud-√pad

hindi: लकड़ी, ढेला, पत्थर, लोहा, डण्डा, रस्सी द्रव्यों में से किसी एक से बिना रक्त के दुःख उत्पन्न करने वाले का चौबीस पण का दण्ड, रक्त उत्पन्न करने में दुगुना, दूषित रक्त को छोड़कर।
english: For one causing pain without blood by any one of the articles wood, clod, stone, iron, stick [or] rope, the penalty [is] twenty-four paṇas; in causing blood, double; except for bad blood.
notes: daṇḍa in the list of articles is a stick (the instrument), not the penalty. "śoṇita-utpādane" = in causing blood [to flow]. duṣṭa-śoṇita = bad (vitiated) blood; sense not further specified.
lines_deva: काष्ठ.लोष्ट.पाषाण.लोह.दण्ड.रज्जु.द्रव्याणाम् अन्यतमेन दुःखम् अशोणितम् उत्पादयतश् चतुर्विंशति.पणो दण्डः, शोणित.उत्पादने द्वि.गुणः, अन्यत्र दुष्ट.शोणितात्
lines_iast: kāṣṭha.loṣṭa.pāṣāṇa.loha.daṇḍa.rajju.dravyāṇām anyatamena duḥkham aśoṇitam utpādayataś caturviṃśati.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, śoṇita.utpādane dvi.guṇaḥ, anyatra duṣṭa.śoṇitāt

hindi: मृत के समान, रक्तहीन रूप से प्रहार करने वाले का, या हाथ और पैर का पारञ्चिक करने वाले का प्रथम साहस-दण्ड; हाथ, पैर, दाँत के तोड़ने में, कान और नाक के काटने में और घाव के फाड़ने में, दूषित घावों को छोड़कर।
english: For one who strikes [a man] bloodlessly, like one dead, or who makes a pārañcika of hand and foot, the first fine for rashness; and in breaking a hand, foot [or] tooth, in cutting off an ear [or] nose, in splitting open a wound; except for bad wounds.

text_flags.why: stray extra c (vidāraṇe cca); the line has only one conjunction ca

notes: pārañcika is obscure and kept untranslated (possibly an injury or disabling of hand and foot); the compound hasta-pāda-pārañcika is read as tat-puruṣa. The object of ghnataḥ is not stated ("[a man]"). mṛta-kalpa = resembling dead. The last clause continues the list: "and in ... splitting open a wound".
lines_deva: मृत.कल्पम् अशोणितं घ्नतो हस्त.पाद.पारञ्चिकं वा कुर्वतः पूर्वः साहस.दण्डः, पाणि.पाद.दन्त.भङ्गे कर्ण.नास.आच्छेदने व्रण.विदारणे च्च, अन्यत्र दुष्ट.व्रणेभ्यः
lines_iast: mṛta.kalpam aśoṇitaṃ ghnato hasta.pāda.pārañcikaṃ vā kurvataḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, pāṇi.pāda.danta.bhaṅge karṇa.nāsa.ācchedane vraṇa.vidāraṇe cca, anyatra duṣṭa.vraṇebhyaḥ

words.gloss: in obstructions of speech, movement, eating

hindi: जाँघ और गर्दन तोड़ने में या आँख फोड़ने में, और वाणी, चेष्टा, भोजन के अवरोध में मध्यम साहस-दण्ड और उठ खड़े होने का व्यय।
english: In breaking the thigh [or] neck, or in splitting the eye, and in obstructing speech, movement [or] eating, the middle fine for rashness and the expense of rising up.
notes: samutthāna-vyaya = expense of rising up (the sense "recovery" only in notes, glossary 4.11).
lines_deva: सक्थि.ग्रीव.आभञ्जने नेत्र.भेदने वा वाक्य.चेष्टा.भोजन.उपरोधेषु च मध्यमः साहस.दण्डः समुत्थान.व्ययश् च
lines_iast: sakthi.grīva.ābhañjane netra.bhedane vā vākya.ceṣṭā.bhojana.uparodheṣu ca madhyamaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ samutthāna.vyayaś ca

hindi: विपत्ति होने पर कण्टकशोधन के लिए ले जाया जाए।
english: In misfortune [he] should be led to the cleansing of thorns.
notes: vipatti = misfortune, ruin; the likely sense is the death of the victim, but the text does not say so. The subject of nīyeta is not stated ("[he]"). kaṇṭaka-śodhana kept literal (glossary 4.1).
lines_deva: विपत्तौ कण्टक.शोधनाय नीयेत
lines_iast: vipattau kaṇṭaka.śodhanāya nīyeta

hindi: बड़े जनसमूह के एक को प्रहार करने पर प्रत्येक का दुगुना दण्ड।
english: Of a great crowd striking one, for each a double penalty.
notes: Read as: when a great crowd strikes one [person], each of them is liable to a double penalty. mahā-jana kept literal (a great number of people). Note the token mahā.janasya-ekaṃ is a hyphen join of two words.
lines_deva: महा.जनस्य-एकं घ्नतः प्रत्येकं द्वि.गुणो दण्डः
lines_iast: mahā.janasya-ekaṃ ghnataḥ pratyekaṃ dvi.guṇo daṇḍaḥ

hindi: “बासी कलह या अनुप्रवेश पर अभियोग नहीं चलाया जाना चाहिए,” ऐसा आचार्य कहते हैं।
english: "A stale quarrel or an entering-in is not to be proceeded against," say the teachers.
notes: anupraveśa is obscure and kept literal ("entering in"); possible senses: intrusion, or joining in a quarrel already begun. paryuṣita = stale (that has passed the night), i.e. an old quarrel. The closing iti is carried by the quotation marks (glossary 3.5).
lines_deva: "पर्युषितः कलहो ऽनुप्रवेशो वा न-अभियोज्यः" इत्य् आचार्याः
lines_iast: "paryuṣitaḥ kalaho 'nupraveśo vā na-abhiyojyaḥ" ity ācāryāḥ

hindi: “अपराधी की मुक्ति नहीं है,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: "There is no release for an offender," says Kautilya.
notes: Closing iti carried by quotation marks only, as in the other "iti kauṭilyaḥ" units; the e-text itself prints no quotation marks around Kautilya's own view, so the marks are the translator's.
lines_deva: न-अस्त्य् अपकारिणो मोक्ष इति कौटिल्यः
lines_iast: na-asty apakāriṇo mokṣa iti kauṭilyaḥ

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. a-√kṣam

hindi: “कलह में पहले आया हुआ जीतता है, क्योंकि सहन न करने वाला आगे दौड़ पड़ता है,” ऐसा आचार्य कहते हैं।
english: "In a quarrel the one who came first wins, for the one who does not endure rushes forward," say the teachers.
notes: pūrva-āgata may mean one who came first (to the court, or to the scene); the text does not say which.
lines_deva: "कलहे पूर्व.आगतो जयति, अक्षममाणो हि प्रधावति" इत्य् आचार्याः
lines_iast: "kalahe pūrva.āgato jayati, akṣamamāṇo hi pradhāvati" ity ācāryāḥ

hindi: “नहीं,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: "No," says Kautilya.
lines_deva: न-इति कौटिल्यः
lines_iast: na-iti kauṭilyaḥ

hindi: पहले या बाद में पहुँचे हुए के साक्षी प्रमाण; साक्षी न होने पर प्रहार या कलह का संकेत।
english: Of one who has approached first or afterwards, the witnesses [are] the authority; when there are no witnesses, the blow or the indication of the quarrel [is].
notes: abhigata (approached) is ambiguous: approached the court/the officer, or approached the other party; the order "first or later" is taken with it. upaliṅgana = indication, mark (obscure; kept literal). ghāta here = blow (not "killing" of glossary 4.7). Predicates are supplied only as bare copulas in brackets in English.
lines_deva: पूर्वं पश्चाद् वा-अभिगतस्य साक्षिणः प्रमाणम्, असाक्षिके घातः कलह.उपलिङ्गनं वा
lines_iast: pūrvaṃ paścād vā-abhigatasya sākṣiṇaḥ pramāṇam, asākṣike ghātaḥ kalaha.upaliṅganaṃ vā

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. a-prati-√brū

hindi: प्रहार के अभियोग का उत्तर न देने वाले का उसी दिन पश्चात्कार।
english: Of one not replying to the charge of a blow, on that very day, the paścāt-kāra (literally "making-behind").
notes: paścāt-kāra is obscure and kept untranslated; literally "making behind / putting behind"; the text does not say what it means.
lines_deva: घात.अभियोगम् अप्रतिब्रुवतस् तद् अहर् एव पश्चात्.कारः
lines_iast: ghāta.abhiyogam apratibruvatas tad ahar eva paścāt.kāraḥ

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. apa-√hṛ

words.gloss: in damaging garment, ornament, money, gold, wares

hindi: कलह में द्रव्य का अपहरण करने वाले का दस पण का दण्ड; छोटे द्रव्य की क्षति में वह और उतना दण्ड; मोटे द्रव्य की क्षति में वह और दुगुना दण्ड; वस्त्र, आभरण, धन, सोना, माल की क्षति में वह और प्रथम साहस-दण्ड।
english: In a quarrel, for one carrying off an article, a penalty of ten paṇas; in damaging a petty article, that and that much as penalty; in damaging a coarse article, that and a double penalty; in damaging a garment, ornament, money, gold [or] wares, that and the first fine for rashness.
notes: tat ("that") is not defined; it probably refers to the article or its value, but the text does not say. hiṃsā = injury, damage (to articles). sthūlaka kept literal "coarse" (doubt, glossary 4.1). hiraṇya = money (gold only in notes), suvarṇa = gold, bhāṇḍa = wares (glossary 5.2, 4.6); bhāṇḍa could also be vessels.
lines_deva: कलहे द्रव्यम् अपहरतो दश.पणो दण्डः, क्षुद्रक.द्रव्य.हिंसायां तच् च तावच् च दण्डः, स्थूलक.द्रव्य.हिंसायां तच् च द्वि.गुणश् च दण्डः, वस्त्र.आभरण.हिरण्य.सुवर्ण.भाण्ड.हिंसायां तच् च पूर्वश् च साहस.दण्डः
lines_iast: kalahe dravyam apaharato daśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, kṣudraka.dravya.hiṃsāyāṃ tac ca tāvac ca daṇḍaḥ, sthūlaka.dravya.hiṃsāyāṃ tac ca dvi.guṇaś ca daṇḍaḥ, vastra.ābharaṇa.hiraṇya.suvarṇa.bhāṇḍa.hiṃsāyāṃ tac ca pūrvaś ca sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. caus. √kṣubh

hindi: दूसरे की दीवार को प्रहार से हिला देने वाले का तीन पण का दण्ड; काटने और तोड़ने में छह पण, और प्रतिकार।
english: For one shaking another's wall by striking, a penalty of three paṇas; in cutting [and] splitting, six paṇas; and the remedy.
notes: pratīkāra = remedy (glossary 14.4), probably repair of the damage; not stated. chedana-bhedane is read as a locative singular of a neuter dvandva (a dual locative would end in -yoḥ).
lines_deva: पर.कुड्यम् अभिघातेन क्षोभयतस् त्रि.पणो दण्डः, छेदन.भेदने षट्.पणः, प्रतीकारश् च
lines_iast: para.kuḍyam abhighātena kṣobhayatas tri.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, chedana.bhedane ṣaṭ.paṇaḥ, pratīkāraś ca

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. pra-√kṣip

hindi: दूसरे के घर में दुःख उत्पन्न करने वाला द्रव्य फेंकने वाले का बारह पण का दण्ड; प्राण को संकट में डालने वाले को फेंकने पर प्रथम साहस-दण्ड।
english: For one throwing into another's house an article causing pain, a penalty of twelve paṇas; [an article] endangering life, the first fine for rashness.
notes: prāṇa-ābādhikam is taken as an elided dravyam (the article), bracketed in English.
lines_deva: दुःख.उत्पादनं द्रव्यम् अन्य.वेश्मनि प्रक्षिपतो द्वादश.पणो दण्डः, प्राण.आबाधिकं पूर्वः साहस.दण्डः
lines_iast: duḥkha.utpādanaṃ dravyam anya.veśmani prakṣipato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, prāṇa.ābādhikaṃ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ

hindi: छोटे पशुओं को लकड़ी आदि से दुःख उत्पन्न करने में एक पण या दुगुना दण्ड; रक्त उत्पन्न करने में दुगुना।
english: In causing pain to small animals with wood and the like, a penalty of a paṇa or double [that]; in causing blood, double.
notes: "paṇo dvi.guṇo vā" read as a paṇa or double (that). "Causing blood" = causing blood to flow.
lines_deva: क्षुद्र.पशूनां काष्ठ.आदिभिर् दुःख.उत्पादने पणो द्वि.गुणो वा दण्डः, शोणित.उत्पादने द्वि.गुणः
lines_iast: kṣudra.paśūnāṃ kāṣṭha.ādibhir duḥkha.utpādane paṇo dvi.guṇo vā daṇḍaḥ, śoṇita.utpādane dvi.guṇaḥ

hindi: बड़े पशुओं के इन्हीं स्थानों में दुगुना दण्ड और उठ खड़े होने का व्यय।
english: For large animals, in just these cases, a double penalty and the expense of rising up.
notes: sthāna (place/instance) is read as the cases of unit 26 (pain with wood and the like, causing blood). Printed sthāneṣv dvi- is regular sandhi.
lines_deva: महा.पशूनाम् एतेष्व् एव स्थानेष्व् द्वि.गुणो दण्डः समुत्थान.व्ययश् च
lines_iast: mahā.paśūnām eteṣv eva sthāneṣv dvi.guṇo daṇḍaḥ samutthāna.vyayaś ca

words.gloss: of trees of town and park

hindi: नगर और उपवन के पुष्प, फल, छाया वाले वृक्षों के अंकुर काटने में छह पण, छोटी शाखा काटने में बारह पण, मोटी शाखा काटने में चौबीस पण, तने के वध में प्रथम साहस-दण्ड, समुच्छेद में मध्यम।
english: Of trees of town [and] park that have flowers, fruit [and] shade: in cutting a shoot, six paṇas; in cutting a small branch, twelve paṇas; in cutting a stout branch, twenty-four paṇas; in destroying the trunk, the first fine for rashness; in cutting off entirely, the middle.

text_flags.why: extra c: ccch; śākhā + chedane gives śākhāc.chedane, as in the preceding kṣudra.śākhāc.chedane

notes: Compound pura-upavana-vanaspatīnām read as trees of town and park (alternative: trees of town-parks). vadha of the trunk = destruction (glossary 4.10 style). samucchitti = cutting off entirely, uprooting. Printed forms with c.ch (phalac.chāyāvatāṃ, prarohac.chedane, śākhāc.chedane) are regular sandhi. Unit 12 prints caturviṃśati without the dot, here catur.viṃśati; both read the same.
lines_deva: पुर.उपवन.वनस्पतीनां पुष्प.फलच्.छायावतां प्ररोहच्.छेदने षट्.पणः, क्षुद्र.शाखाच्.छेदने द्वादश.पणः, पीन.शाखाच्.च्छेदने चतुर्.विंशति.पणः, स्कन्ध.वधे पूर्वः साहस.दण्डः, समुच्छित्तौ मध्यमः
lines_iast: pura.upavana.vanaspatīnāṃ puṣpa.phalac.chāyāvatāṃ prarohac.chedane ṣaṭ.paṇaḥ, kṣudra.śākhāc.chedane dvādaśa.paṇaḥ, pīna.śākhāc.cchedane catur.viṃśati.paṇaḥ, skandha.vadhe pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, samucchittau madhyamaḥ

words.gloss: in shrubs and creepers having flowers, fruit, shade
in trees of holy places, penance groves, cremation grounds

hindi: पुष्प, फल, छाया वाली झाड़ियों, लताओं में आधे दण्ड, और पुण्य स्थानों, तपोवनों, श्मशानों के वृक्षों में।
english: In shrubs [and] creepers having flowers, fruit [and] shade, half penalties; and in the trees of holy places, penance groves [and] cremation grounds.
notes: Reading: "puṣpa-phala-chāyāvat" qualifies both gulma and latā. The final compound is read as trees of holy places, of penance groves and of cremation grounds.
lines_deva: पुष्प.फलच्.छायावद्.गुल्म.लतास्व् अर्ध.दण्डाः, पुण्य.स्थान.तपो.वन.श्मशान.द्रुमेषु च
lines_iast: puṣpa.phalac.chāyāvad.gulma.latāsv ardha.daṇḍāḥ, puṇya.sthāna.tapo.vana.śmaśāna.drumeṣu ca

hindi: सीमा के वृक्षों, चैत्यों और चिह्नित वृक्षों में तथा राजा के वनों में वे ही दण्ड दुगुने किए जाएँ।
english: In boundary trees, in caityas and in marked trees, and in the king's forests, those very penalties are to be made double.
notes: caitya kept untranslated (glossary 5.2); it may be a tree or a sacred object, the text does not say. "those very penalties" refers to the penalties of units 28-29. ālakṣita = marked/noticeable (trees).
lines_deva: सीम.वृक्षेषु चैत्येषु द्रुमेष्व् आलक्षितेषु च
त एव द्वि.गुणा दण्डाः कार्या राज.वनेषु च
lines_iast: sīma.vṛkṣeṣu caityeṣu drumeṣv ālakṣiteṣu ca
ta eva dvi.guṇā daṇḍāḥ kāryā rāja.vaneṣu ca
